opening.argument: The central activity is a technical walkthrough: the speaker shows how to build a ZK-EVM Layer 2 blockchain on an Ethereum testnet, with diagrams and deployment configuration supporting that instructional purpose. The roughly 25 ETH discussed is part of the testnet development setup, not a promise of real-value returns. The speaker also warns against exporting a main wallet's private key and says the funding page will not ask viewers to connect a wallet or sign transactions or messages. Wallet and key handling appear in the context of building and testing infrastructure, not a request for funds or credentials.

citations.quote: I'll show you how you can create your very own ZKEVM Layer 2 blockchain built on top of an Ethereum testnet.
Once you paste your wallet address in here, you can click, start mining, and you want around 25 ETH for this next step.
At no point, I will ever export my main wallet's private key.
It's not going to ask you to connect your wallet.
